metric_policy.any: anchor correct if any positive-overlap opposing interval has a matching label
metric_policy.max: anchor correct if a matching label ties for greatest unioned accumulated overlap duration
metric_policy.pred_anchor: precision-like: correct predicted anchors / predicted anchors
metric_policy.gt_anchor: recall-like: correct GT anchors / GT anchors
metric_policy.f1: harmonic mean per video, then macro mean over GT-positive videos
metric_policy.matching: not one-to-one; each anchor is judged independently
